Explore our events in Abu Dhabi

    Yas Island is the place to go to catch an Abu Dhabi concert or show. It doesn’t matter what genre of music you love, what tickles your funny bone, or what spectacle entrances you; Yas Island has an event to match. Take your pick from the best concerts in the UAE, stand up performances featuring world-class comedians, musicals for kids and adults, plus stage shows, NBA games, UFC showdowns, Yas Marina circuit events around the Abu Dhabi GP and a whole lot more. From hot-right-now performers, to classic acts, there’s something for everyone. Watch this space to keep track of upcoming events in Abu Dhabi, and grab those tickets before they sell out!
